external.description: Third-party API key — tenant admin supplies the value via the Apps-page shield modal

App-data encryption key — platform-generated, no admin action needed. Dev and stable each get their own independent value (security-first default). Flip sharedAcrossTracks to true ONLY for an app-issued token that must validate across a dev→stable promotion.

renovate.context: Separate frontend (React+Vite) and backend (Go) containers. Update npm and Go module dependencies independently. Docker base images for both containers.

logMonitor.context: Two-container app: React frontend + Go API backend. Common errors: frontend chunk loading failures, backend API panics, cross-container networking issues, health check failures on either container.
